limitations: This is a three-seed I1, 5000-particle, 128-box, white-noise-1 campaign with a five-iteration cap; it does not replace a converged 100k/256 K=4 completion run or real-data validation.
RECOVAR did not converge before the cap and final-all-data reconstruction was not forced; final_class maps are exact copies of the last numbered half-map averages.
RELION Class3D emits full class maps rather than independent half maps, so half-map FSC and masked half-map resolution are outside this campaign's scope.

The checked per-class 0.143 GT resolutions come from the independently sealed rigid-alignment endpoint evaluator; the frozen trajectory gate uses the unmodified shellwise FSC audit and retains its own GT FSC-AUC values.
Peak HBM is a lower bound sampled every five seconds from engine-specific nvidia-smi monitors, not an allocator-exact maximum.
The registry term TRAJECTORY_EXACT means every frozen FSC/GT-delta/assignment threshold passed; it is not a claim of bytewise map identity.
The five-iteration O/I1 jobs exercise the fixed non-C1 local-search route introduced by source commit 22efd8065; earlier c75cbfffc O/I1 attempts stopped at iteration 2 in an unsupported dense route.
